# E2E Test Corpus (Synthetic)

These documents are **synthetic test fixtures** for end-to-end validation.
They are **not** actual university regulations.

Used by optional live NVIDIA integration tests when
`UNIASSIST_RUN_NVIDIA_INTEGRATION=1`.

| File | Topic |
|------|-------|
| `academic_leave.txt` | Academic leave applications |
| `exam_rules.txt` | Missed examination procedures |
| `dormitory.txt` | Dormitory accommodation |
| `tuition.txt` | Tuition payment deadlines |
